blocks.directed: In Part XXXII, we learned that the whole universe is present within the seed of the Heart.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: In Part XXXIII, we learned that every action of worship occurs within that same Heart.
blocks.directed: In Part XXXIII, we learned that every action of worship occurs within that same Heart.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The world is not merely something that appears and then must be escaped.
blocks.directed: The world is not merely something that appears and then must be escaped.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: It is the manifestation through which consciousness can recognise its own freedom.
blocks.directed: It is the manifestation through which consciousness can recognise its own freedom.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: And the ritual is one possible expression of that recognition.
blocks.directed: And the ritual is one possible expression of that recognition.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: ### The final joke
blocks.directed: ### The final joke

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Imagine a person performing this elaborate ritual perfectly.
blocks.directed: Imagine a person performing this elaborate ritual perfectly.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Every syllable pronounced correctly.
blocks.directed: Every syllable pronounced correctly.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Every placement exact.
blocks.directed: Every placement exact.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Every flower fresh.
blocks.directed: Every flower fresh.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Every direction sealed.
blocks.directed: Every direction sealed.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Every clap sufficiently audible.
blocks.directed: Every clap sufficiently audible.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Every repetition counted.
blocks.directed: Every repetition counted.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Every gesture correctly executed.
blocks.directed: Every gesture correctly executed.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The practitioner reaches the end.
blocks.directed: The practitioner reaches the end.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: They offer themselves to the supreme Lord.
blocks.directed: They offer themselves to the supreme Lord.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: And Bhairava asks:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And Bhairava asks:

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: “What exactly are you offering?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “What exactly are you offering?”

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: “Myself, Lord.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Myself, Lord.”

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: “Very good. And who are you?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Very good. And who are you?”

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: “A limited person seeking the divine.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “A limited person seeking the divine.”

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: “Are you certain?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Are you certain?”

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: “Well, I've completed the ritual.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Well, I've completed the ritual.”

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: “Yes, excellent. The flowers were lovely. But who was aware of the ritual?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Yes, excellent. The flowers were lovely. But who was aware of the ritual?”

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: “I was.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I was.”

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: “And what is the nature of that awareness?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “And what is the nature of that awareness?”

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The practitioner hesitates.
blocks.directed: The practitioner hesitates.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: And there, right there, the actual teaching begins.
blocks.directed: And there, right there, the actual teaching begins.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Because the purpose was never simply to move objects around an altar.
blocks.directed: Because the purpose was never simply to move objects around an altar.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The purpose was to recognise the reality in which the whole ceremony occurred.
blocks.directed: The purpose was to recognise the reality in which the whole ceremony occurred.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The movements.
blocks.directed: The movements.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The sounds.
blocks.directed: The sounds.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The intentions.
blocks.directed: The intentions.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The sensations.
blocks.directed: The sensations.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The image of the Goddess.
blocks.directed: The image of the Goddess.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The sense of being a worshipper.
blocks.directed: The sense of being a worshipper.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The act of offering.
blocks.directed: The act of offering.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: All manifest within awareness.
blocks.directed: All manifest within awareness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: And Abhinavagupta asks whether that awareness, in its supreme nature, was ever fundamentally separate from Bhairava.
blocks.directed: And Abhinavagupta asks whether that awareness, in its supreme nature, was ever fundamentally separate from Bhairava.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: His answer is no.
blocks.directed: His answer is no.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The worshipper was seeking Śiva through the power of Śiva.
blocks.directed: The worshipper was seeking Śiva through the power of Śiva.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The ritual was an expression of Śakti.
blocks.directed: The ritual was an expression of Śakti.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The offering belonged to consciousness.
blocks.directed: The offering belonged to consciousness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: And the Heart was never absent from the beginning.
blocks.directed: And the Heart was never absent from the beginning.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: **The real offering was the imagined distance between the worshipper and the worshipped.**
blocks.directed: **The real offering was the imagined distance between the worshipper and the worshipped.**

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: And once that distance is recognised as nonultimate, the entire universe becomes intelligible as the self-manifestation of the supreme.
blocks.directed: And once that distance is recognised as nonultimate, the entire universe becomes intelligible as the self-manifestation of the supreme.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The ceremony is finished.
blocks.directed: The ceremony is finished.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The fire has consumed its fuel.
blocks.directed: The fire has consumed its fuel.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The flowers remain on the altar.
blocks.directed: The flowers remain on the altar.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The body is still present.
blocks.directed: The body is still present.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The senses still operate.
blocks.directed: The senses still operate.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Thought may continue.
blocks.directed: Thought may continue.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: The world has not disappeared.
blocks.directed: The world has not disappeared.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: But the assumption of absolute separation no longer needs to govern the understanding of experience.
blocks.directed: But the assumption of absolute separation no longer needs to govern the understanding of experience.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: That is the supreme interpretation of ritual.
blocks.directed: That is the supreme interpretation of ritual.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: And the next question is now unavoidable.
blocks.directed: And the next question is now unavoidable.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: **What happens when somebody remembers this even while doing ordinary things?**
blocks.directed: **What happens when somebody remembers this even while doing ordinary things?**

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Walking.
blocks.directed: Walking.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Eating.
blocks.directed: Eating.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Speaking.
blocks.directed: Speaking.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Working.
blocks.directed: Working.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Thinking.
blocks.directed: Thinking.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Breathing.
blocks.directed: Breathing.

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: Does the whole of life become worship?
blocks.directed: Does the whole of life become worship?

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: And if it does, what remains of the distinction between sacred practice and ordinary existence?
blocks.directed: And if it does, what remains of the distinction between sacred practice and ordinary existence?

blocks.section: Closing: The Universe Was Never Waiting for You to Put It on
blocks.text: That is where Abhinavagupta is taking us next.
blocks.directed: That is where Abhinavagupta is taking us next.
